rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm prevented: dense bold pseudo-headings make a projected slide read like an unchunked document and hide the actual slide structure. The body has ten bolded leads, including lines 11, 17, 27, 39, 49, 59, 61, 63, 65, and 71, while the file has no `##` cuts; the whole lecture is one rendered chunk.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Promote the real teaching breaks to `##` headings and flatten most full-sentence bold leads to ordinary prose or short handles.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm prevented: projection overload that makes the lecture impossible to scan. Ran `node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/lectures/grounded.md --report`; real output: `files: 0; slides: 0; oversized: 0; every slide is within limits` (exit status 0), because the checker does not scan this shared lecture path. Direct expanded-body inspection shows one unbroken `##` chunk spanning lines 1-80 and about 950 body words, so the cap’s harm is present despite the checker blind spot.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Add conceptual `##` cuts so the projected lecture is a sequence of sub-210-word slides rather than one unbroken chunk.
